# Kyujo (bundled subset)

These files are taken unmodified from Kyujo, the native port of the first Pokémon Stadium by Dan B. Cooper, at commit
`7b66b752ec364e015296a22c88409116827ee09e`. They are the renderer, the menu, the Transfer Pak / Game Boy cartridge code
and the GPU back end that Kyujo2 builds on. Kyujo2's changes to them are in `../../patches/`
(`kyujo2-*.patch`, `*-word-order.patch`, `gpu_gles-kyujo2.patch`) and are applied at build time.
